mapper.select: SELECT a.account_id, a.cash_balance, po.product_option_id, p.product_type, p.kor_co_nm AS financial_company_name, p.fin_prdt_nm AS product_name, p.max_limit, po.save_trm AS saving_term, po.intr_rate AS interest_rate, po.intr_rate2 AS maximum_interest_rate, po.rsrv_type AS reserve_type FROM product_options po INNER JOIN products p ON p.product_id = po.product_id LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.user_id = #{userId} WHERE po.product_option_id = #{productOptionId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO holding_products ( account_id, product_option_id, join_amount, applied_rate, total_installments, paid_installments, payment_date, start_date, maturity_date, status ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{productOptionId}, #{joinAmount}, #{appliedRate}, #{totalInstallments}, #{paidInstallments}, #{paymentDate}, #{startDate}, #{maturityDate}, #{status} )
INSERT INTO product_transactions ( holding_product_id, type, amount, installment_number, status ) VALUES ( #{holdingProductId}, 'SUBSCRIBE', #{amount}, #{installmentNumber}, 'COMPLETED' )
INSERT INTO account_transactions ( account_id, type, amount, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, 'WITHDRAW', #{amount}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT hp.holding_product_id, hp.product_option_id, p.product_type, p.kor_co_nm AS financial_company_name, p.fin_prdt_nm AS product_name, po.rsrv_type_nm AS reserve_type_name, hp.join_amount, hp.applied_rate, po.save_trm AS saving_term, hp.total_installments, hp.paid_installments, hp.payment_date AS next_payment_date, hp.start_date, hp.maturity_date, hp.status FROM holding_products hp INNER JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = hp.account_id INNER JOIN product_options po ON po.product_option_id = hp.product_option_id INNER JOIN products p ON p.product_id = po.product_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND hp.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY hp.created_at DESC, hp.holding_product_id DESC

SELECT hp.holding_product_id, hp.account_id AS accountId, hp.product_option_id, p.product_type, p.kor_co_nm AS financial_company_name, p.fin_prdt_nm AS product_name, po.rsrv_type_nm AS reserve_type_name, hp.join_amount, hp.applied_rate, po.save_trm AS saving_term, hp.total_installments, hp.paid_installments, hp.payment_date AS next_payment_date, hp.start_date, hp.maturity_date, hp.status FROM holding_products hp INNER JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = hp.account_id INNER JOIN product_options po ON po.product_option_id = hp.product_option_id INNER JOIN products p ON p.product_id = po.product_id WHERE hp.holding_product_id = #{holdingProductId} AND a.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE accounts SET cash_balance = cash_balance + #{amount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
UPDATE holding_products SET status = 'TERMINATED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE holding_product_id = #{holdingProductId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_transactions ( holding_product_id, type, amount, interest_amount, interest_tax_amount, status, terminated_at ) VALUES ( #{holdingProductId}, 'TERMINATE', #{amount}, #{interestAmount}, #{interestTaxAmount}, 'COMPLETED', #{terminatedAt} )
INSERT INTO account_transactions ( account_id, type, amount, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, 'DEPOSIT', #{amount}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pt.interest_amount), 0) FROM product_transactions pt INNER JOIN holding_products hp ON hp.holding_product_id = pt.holding_product_id INNER JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = hp.account_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND pt.type IN ('TERMINATE', 'MATURITY') AND pt.status = 'COMPLETED' AND pt.created_at >= #{yearStart} AND pt.created_at < #{nextYearStart}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(join_amount), 0) FROM holding_products WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT pt.product_transaction_id AS productTransactionId, hp.holding_product_id AS holdingProductId, pt.type AS transactionType, p.product_type AS productType, p.kor_co_nm AS financialCompanyName, p.fin_prdt_nm AS productName, pt.amount, pt.status, COALESCE(pt.terminated_at, pt.created_at) AS processedAt FROM holding_products hp INNER JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = hp.account_id INNER JOIN product_options po ON po.product_option_id = hp.product_option_id INNER JOIN products p ON p.product_id = po.product_id INNER JOIN product_transactions pt ON pt.holding_product_id = hp.holding_product_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND pt.type IN ( 'SUBSCRIBE', 'PAYMENT', 'ADDITIONAL_PAYMENT', 'TERMINATE', 'MATURITY' ) ORDER BY COALESCE(pt.terminated_at, pt.created_at) DESC, pt.product_transaction_id DESC
